SELECT 
  fished_date_doy, 
  cls, 
  boat,
  COUNT(*) as trips_completed,
  ROUND(AVG(yt), 1) as avg_yt_per_boat,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt
FROM trips 
WHERE fished_date_season = 2
GROUP BY fished_date_doy, cls, boat
ORDER BY fished_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 50

SELECT 
  fished_date_doy, 
  COUNT(*) as trips,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cls = 'day_1_5' THEN yt ELSE NULL END), 1) as day_1_5_avg_yt,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN cls = 'overnight' THEN yt ELSE NULL END), 1) as overnight_avg_yt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cls = 'day_1_5' THEN yt ELSE 0 END) as day_1_5_total_yt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN cls = 'overnight' THEN yt ELSE 0 END) as overnight_total_yt
FROM trips 
WHERE fished_date_season = 2
GROUP BY fished_date_doy
ORDER BY fished_date_doy
LIMIT 80
